what-is-apiary.intro: Apiary is our shared design system that unites teams with consistent, reusable components and clear guidelines — helping us build better digital experiences faster and more collaboratively.
what-is-apiary.body: Apiary is more than just a library of components — it's a shared foundation for how we design and build digital experiences. It combines visual styles, code, accessibility standards, and usage guidelines all in one place. Apiary helps us scale quality, speed up delivery, and create consistent, user-friendly products across teams and platforms.

blocks.title: Benefits of a design system
list: Consistency across teams and platforms — a shared source of truth ensures visual and functional alignment
Faster development and testing — reusable components reduce build time and speed up delivery
Scalable growth — documentation and version control make it easier to evolve products
Reduced errors and miscommunication — clear usage guidance helps teams avoid costly rework
Fewer bottlenecks — self-service access to components frees up design and development resources
Improved collaboration — shared language and tools enable smoother cross-functional work
Built-in accessibility — standards embedded into components improve inclusivity
Faster onboarding — new team members ramp up faster with a single place to learn

blocks.title: Why the name "Apiary"?
blocks.body: We chose the name Apiary because it reflects the values of collaboration, structure, and shared effort — much like how bees build something greater together.
list: Structured organisation — like an apiary of hives, the system brings order to complexity
Collaboration and community — teams contribute to and benefit from a shared ecosystem
Efficiency and productivity — reusable components reduce duplication and accelerate delivery
Consistency and cohesion — uniform experiences across platforms, like honey from a hive
Growth and adaptability — the system evolves as our products and needs grow
Nurturing environment — Apiary provides a safe, creative space for innovation
Resource management — designs and patterns are reused and refined, not reinvented

blocks.title: Who uses Apiary?
blocks.body: Apiary supports everyone involved in delivering digital products. Whether you're designing screens, writing content, building components, managing features, or reviewing work, Apiary helps speed delivery, improve collaboration, and maintain a consistent user experience.
list: Designers — with ready-to-use components and patterns
Developers — with documented specs and reusable code
Content Designers — with access to content styles and UX guidance
Product Managers — with shared standards and faster delivery
Testers and QA — with consistent behaviour and accessibility practices
New team members — with onboarding resources to get up to speed

why-apiary-matters.intro: Apiary empowers our organisation to deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality digital products faster — creating real business value and enabling scalable growth.
why-apiary-matters.body: As our digital products grow in complexity and scale, teams often struggle with duplicated work, inconsistent user experiences, and slower delivery — all due to the absence of a unified system. Apiary tackles these challenges by providing a shared foundation of reusable components, clear standards, and comprehensive guidelines that empower teams to:

list: Maintain consistency across teams and platforms, strengthening user trust and brand integrity
Speed up development with ready-to-use components and straightforward guidance
Minimise errors and miscommunication through a single, reliable source of truth
Support scalable growth with well-documented standards and version control
Encourage collaboration between design, development, content, and product teams
Embed accessibility to ensure inclusive experiences for all users
Streamline onboarding to reduce ramp-up time for new team members

blocks.title: The business impact
list: Faster time to market — less duplication and clearer processes speed up feature delivery
Cost savings — reduced design and development rework frees resources for innovation
Improved product quality — consistent design and accessibility increase user satisfaction
Stronger cross-team alignment — shared language and tools reduce bottlenecks and misaligned priorities
Future-proof scalability — a centralised system makes adapting to new requirements easier and less costly

blocks.title: What we risk without Apiary
list: Continued inefficiencies due to duplicated work and inconsistent design
Increased costs and delays from misunderstandings and rework
Fragmented user experiences that erode trust and satisfaction
Limited ability to scale products effectively as demand grows
Overreliance on key individuals instead of enabling self-service across teams

blocks.title: Next steps
blocks.body: Apiary is foundational to our product delivery success. To fully realise its value, continued investment and organisational support are essential. Discover how Apiary is already supporting teams in the What is Apiary page, and explore role-specific onboarding and resources coming soon.

why-apiary-matters.cta: Ready to unlock Apiary's full potential? Talk to the Apiary team to learn how design system investment accelerates delivery and drives growth.

design-principles.intro: These principles were shaped by our team and reflect how we want to work — with empathy, clarity, and a shared commitment to better outcomes.
design-principles.body: They guide us in creating accessible, intuitive, and meaningful experiences that serve real people and reflect our values. These aren't just words — they're reminders of how we show we care, collaborate, and continually improve together.

blocks.title: 1. Design with empathy
blocks.body: We put people first. Every decision starts with understanding the needs, goals, and realities of those who use our products.

blocks.title: 2. Make it simple and usable
blocks.body: Clear, focused design helps people get things done — fast. We eliminate clutter and prioritise ease.

blocks.title: 3. Be inclusive by default
blocks.body: We design for everyone. Accessibility, clarity, and flexibility are built in — not added later.

blocks.title: 4. Build with consistency
blocks.body: Shared styles and patterns create trust, speed up delivery, and reduce rework. Familiarity matters.

blocks.title: 5. Collaborate openly
blocks.body: Apiary is built by many. We share ideas early, document clearly, and work together to improve every step.

blocks.title: 6. Evolve continuously
blocks.body: Design is never done. We test, learn, and adapt — always with the goal of doing better.

design-principles.cta: These principles are living, not static — and they reflect what our team believes matters most. We'll revisit and evolve them as we grow.

start-using.intro: One place to help everyone build consistent, accessible, user-first products — faster.
start-using.body: Whether you're a designer, developer, content strategist, or product manager, Apiary provides the tools, resources, and guidance you need to work efficiently, collaborate seamlessly, and deliver high-quality digital experiences.

blocks.title: What you'll learn here
list: Understand what Apiary is and when to use it
Discover where to find the right tools, specs, and resources
See how Apiary supports consistent, accessible, and scalable work
Access tailored links to role-specific onboarding and guides

blocks.title: When to use Apiary
list: Starting a new feature
Designing or building UI
Writing or reviewing content
Planning delivery with your squad
Onboarding into a new team or project
blocks.note: Apiary helps reduce duplication, maintain accessibility, align across teams, and speed up delivery.

blocks.title: What you'll find inside
list: Foundations — core design principles, colours, typography, accessibility standards, and layout guidelines
Design Tokens — centralised variables for colours, spacing, fonts, and more to ensure consistency and easy updates
Components — reusable UI elements for web and mobile apps designed for consistency and efficiency
Patterns — pre-built design solutions for common UI problems, helping avoid duplication
How-to Guides — practical role-specific onboarding and workflow guides to get the most from Apiary

blocks.title: Start by role
list: 🎨 Designer Onboarding — use shared Figma libraries, document components, and collaborate effectively with developers
💻 Developer Onboarding — implement designs accurately using design specs, Storybook, and reusable design tokens to speed development
✍️ Content Onboarding (coming soon) — create consistent UI copy, align content with patterns, and contribute to Apiary documentation

blocks.title: Still have questions?
blocks.body: We're here to help! Reach out on Slack, Teams, or contact the Apiary team directly for support.

start-using.cta: Next steps — ready to dive deeper? Visit the Designer Onboarding and Developer Onboarding pages for detailed role-specific guidance.

designer-onboarding.intro: This guide outlines what you need to know and do to effectively use Apiary in your design work and collaborate smoothly with your team.
designer-onboarding.body: Apiary supports designers by providing shared components, principles, and tools to create consistent, accessible, and high-quality user experiences. This page walks you through key steps to get started, including learning our guidelines, using the right tools, and contributing your work back to the system. Detailed guides and resources are being developed and will be added here soon.

blocks.title: Learn the guidelines
list: Explore Apiary's core design principles that shape our approach
Familiarise yourself with foundational elements like colour, typography, and accessibility
Understand the components and patterns used across web and mobile products
Learn how to use design tokens in Figma to keep designs consistent

blocks.title: Get the tools
list: Use the official Figma project template to start new product designs
Make sure you have access to the RAADS Figma design system assets
Review the structure and correct use of design tokens in your designs
Follow the branching and version control process when updating designs collaboratively

blocks.title: Contribute to Apiary
list: Share your work regularly with the design team for feedback and alignment
Once designs are approved, create a branch in the RAADS Figma file and add your work
Submit a merge request to the design team for review and approval
After merging, document your changes following Apiary's documentation process
Communicate your updates to the wider team through the designated channels

blocks.title: Resources (links coming soon)
list: Figma project template
Apiary design tokens guide
Documentation and communication processes
blocks.note: Detailed step-by-step guides and templates for these areas will be available soon. Check back regularly for updates.

designer-onboarding.cta: Need help? If you have any questions or ideas, reach out to the Apiary team anytime. We're here to support your design journey.

developer-onboarding.intro: A practical and future-focused guide for getting involved with Apiary.
developer-onboarding.body: This page guides developers working on RAA's digital products to use Apiary efficiently. Apiary provides a shared system of design foundations, components, and documentation that promotes consistency, quality, and faster delivery.

blocks.title: What Apiary offers
list: Foundations — core design elements like colour, typography, spacing, and design tokens
Components — reusable UI building blocks for web and mobile
Patterns — proven solutions for common design and development challenges

blocks.title: How designs are shared
blocks.body: Designers share visual specifications via Figma, usually linked in Jira tickets. You can inspect styles and tokens directly in Figma Dev Mode for precise implementation details. Apiary's documentation complements this by providing guidance and standards.

blocks.title: The role of Storybook
blocks.body: Storybook will become a key tool to speed up development. It will provide an interactive library of coded components, helping you:
list: Quickly find existing components ready for use
Access live examples and detailed specs
Review guidelines for new or updated features before coding
blocks.note: Together, Figma and Storybook will streamline your workflow and reduce rework.

blocks.title: Why use Apiary?
list: Build faster with reusable, well-documented components
Maintain consistency across teams and platforms
Ensure accessibility is built in from the start
Reduce back-and-forth with designers and other stakeholders

blocks.title: How you can help
list: Report issues or gaps you find
Suggest improvements or new components
Collaborate closely with designers during development

developer-onboarding.cta: 💬 Questions or ideas? Reach out to the Apiary team or your squad designer anytime.
